name: Toggle
description:
A two-state button (aria-pressed). It has no look of its own - hand its attributes to a Button, which paints the pressed state through data-pressed:

  Toggle(pressed: true, aria_label: "Bold") { |toggle| Button(**toggle, variant: :outline, icon: true) { Icon(:bold) } }
  Toggle(class: "size-4 rounded-full") { "…" }   # a plain <button> you style yourself

Standalone it flips itself (`appica-ui--toggle`) and emits `appica-ui--toggle:change` with { pressed }. Inside a ToggleGroup it's pressed when the group's value includes its `value:` and the group manages it. Standalone, `name:` submits `value:` with a form while pressed (and `unchecked_value:` while released) through a hidden input the controller keeps in sync.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Toggle(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
Composing with Button
examples.notes: A block that takes an argument receives the toggle's attributes (Appica's `render` prop).

examples.name: States
Reacting to changes
examples.notes: `appica-ui--toggle:change` carries { pressed }; here it swaps the icon, variant, label and helper text.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "border-border flex w-full max-w-74 items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border p-4", data: { demo: "notifications" }) do
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-0.5") do
      span(class: "text-foreground-intense text-sm font-medium") { "Notifications" }
      span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs", data: { demo: "hint" }) { "You'll be notified about new activity" }
    end
    Toggle(pressed: true, aria_label: "Mute notifications") do |toggle|
      Button(**toggle, variant: :primary, icon: true) do
        Icon(:bell, data: { demo: "on" })
        Icon(:bell_off, data: { demo: "off" }, hidden: true)
      end
    end
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const card = document.querySelector("[data-demo=notifications]")
      card.addEventListener("appica-ui--toggle:change", ({ target, detail: { pressed } }) => {
        card.querySelector("[data-demo=hint]").textContent = pressed ? "You'll be notified about new activity" : "All notifications are paused"
        target.setAttribute("aria-label", pressed ? "Mute notifications" : "Enable notifications")
        target.classList.toggle("bg-primary", pressed)
        target.classList.toggle("text-primary-foreground", pressed)
        target.classList.toggle("before:bg-background-muted", !pressed)
        card.querySelector("[data-demo=on]").hidden = !pressed
        card.querySelector("[data-demo=off]").hidden = pressed
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  ToggleGroup(multiple:, orientation:, disabled:, loop_focus:, include_hidden:, **given(value:, name:), default_value: [ "center" ], aria_label: "Text alignment") do
    instance_exec(&ALIGNMENT_TOGGLES)
  end
end

examples.name: Single selection
Multiple selection
examples.code:
phlex do
  ToggleGroup(multiple: true, default_value: [ "bold" ], aria_label: "Text formatting") do
    { bold: "Bold", italic: "Italic", underline: "Underline" }.each do |value, text|
      Toggle(value:, aria_label: text) { |toggle| Button(**toggle, variant: :ghost, icon: true) { Icon(value) } }
    end
  end
end

Disabled
Color swatches
examples.notes: Bare toggles styled as swatches; the pressed one gets a ring. `name:` submits the choice.
examples.code:
swatches = { sage: [ "Sage", "#8fb478" ], terracotta: [ "Terracotta", "#cc8259" ], sand: [ "Sand", "#d9ba6e" ], blush: [ "Blush", "#db9385" ], denim: [ "Denim", "#7e9cc9" ] }

phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-start gap-3", data: { demo: "swatches" }) do
    span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm") do
      plain "Color - "
      span(class: "text-foreground-intense font-medium", data: { demo: "color" }) { "Sage" }
    end
    ToggleGroup(name: "color", default_value: [ "sage" ], aria_label: "Swatch color", class: "gap-3") do
      swatches.each do |value, (name, color)|
        Toggle(value:, aria_label: name, style: "background-color: #{color}", data: { name: },
          class: "after:ring-border-inverse outline-ring relative size-4 cursor-pointer rounded-full outline-offset-2 transition-transform after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:-inset-0.5 after:scale-50 after:rounded-full after:opacity-0 after:ring-1 after:transition after:duration-200 after:ease-[cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.5)] active:scale-90 data-pressed:after:scale-100 data-pressed:after:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:after:transition-none")
      end
    end
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const demo = document.querySelector("[data-demo=swatches]")
      demo.addEventListener("appica-ui--toggle-group:change", ({ detail: { value } }) => {
        const pressed = demo.querySelector(`[data-slot=toggle][value="${value[0]}"]`)
        demo.querySelector("[data-demo=color]").textContent = pressed ? pressed.dataset.name : "None"
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: RTL

example_helpers.ALIGNMENT_TOGGLES:
ALIGNMENT_TOGGLES = proc do
  ALIGNMENTS.each do |value, text|
    Toggle(value:, aria_label: text) { |toggle| Button(**toggle, variant: :ghost, icon: true) { Icon(:"align_#{value}") } }
  end
end
example_helpers.ALIGNMENTS: ALIGNMENTS = { left: "Align left", center: "Align center", right: "Align right" }.freeze
